thesis: The morning thesis holds: last 29.06 is above SMA20 26.83, SMA50 25.63 and SMA200 22.32 with relative strength +0.52, after a Q3 print with revenue +8.2% YoY and net income +118% YoY at low multiples (forward P/E 8.74, EV/EBITDA 8.64), and health care (XLV) leads the risk-off rotation. Today's -0.32 drift on light volume (247k) cooled RSI from 70.8 to 67.6 without breaking structure; the day low 28.51 held above the 11-06 low of 27.80. The edge is still only a limit entry in the 28.00-28.60 zone (reward/risk about 1.59 to 31.0 from the 28.30 midpoint); at 29.06 reward/risk is about 0.9, so do not chase.
invalidation: A daily close below 26.60, or a close below the 11-06 low of 27.80 that does not recover quickly, undoes the post-earnings breakout.
